WITH promotion_filtered AS (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N'
),
date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
customer_demographics_filtered AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd_education_status = 'College'
),
store_sales_grouped AS (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sum_ss_quantity,
        COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS cnt_ss_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS sum_ss_list_price,
        COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS cnt_ss_list_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_ss_coupon_amt,
        COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_ss_coupon_amt,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_ss_sales_price,
        COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_ss_sales_price
    FROM date_dim_filtered AS dd
    JOIN store_sales AS ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion_filtered AS pr ON ss.ss_promo_sk = pr.p_promo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics_filtered AS cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk
),
item_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        SUM(sg.sum_ss_quantity) AS sum_ss_quantity,
        SUM(sg.cnt_ss_quantity) AS cnt_ss_quantity,
        SUM(sg.sum_ss_list_price) AS sum_ss_list_price,
        SUM(sg.cnt_ss_list_price) AS cnt_ss_list_price,
        SUM(sg.sum_ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_ss_coupon_amt,
        SUM(sg.cnt_ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_ss_coupon_amt,
        SUM(sg.sum_ss_sales_price) AS sum_ss_sales_price,
        SUM(sg.cnt_ss_sales_price) AS cnt_ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales_grouped AS sg
    JOIN item AS i ON sg.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY i.i_item_id
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    sum_ss_quantity / NULLIF(cnt_ss_quantity, 0) AS agg1,
    sum_ss_list_price / NULLIF(cnt_ss_list_price, 0) AS agg2,
    sum_ss_coupon_amt / NULLIF(cnt_ss_coupon_amt, 0) AS agg3,
    sum_ss_sales_price / NULLIF(cnt_ss_sales_price, 0) AS agg4
FROM item_aggregates
ORDER BY i_item_id
LIMIT 100
